name: Himehama Shiki
source:
A smart adult male in a black suit, black shirt, and black wingtips.

Driving a black coupe, he is busy going about his business during the day, but at night he transforms into a sadistic trainer, training beautiful, voluptuous maids.

His pattern of speech can be a bit standoffish but he maintains a level of formality due to the nature of his profession. He is a thorough professional regarding his work and tries his best to do it perfectly.
